column1: # Turkish (tr) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Status: in progress. Untranslated keys fall back to English; `complete_menus` stays false until
# every source key has a Turkish row.
# Clean-room: every entry is written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Turkish computing and image-editing vocabulary (katman, seçim, fırça, maske ...). No proprietary
# localisation resource, string table or product UI is consulted or copied; add entries the same
# way. Product and technology names (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft, OpenType, RGB, CMYK, Lab, PSD, PNG,
# JPEG, WebP, OpenEXR, AVIF …) stay as they are; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
# Plural rule: one form (`plural_none` in i18n/mod.rs); a noun after a number stays singular.
# Placeholders: Turkish case suffixes follow the vowels of the word they attach to, which a
# `{name}` can't predict. Don't attach a suffix to a placeholder ("{name}'i sil"); rephrase so the
# placeholder stands alone ("Sil: {name}") or follows a noun that carries the suffix
# Phase 3.1 — top-level menus, File menu, Edit menu
# Labels every registered language must carry (tests in i18n/mod.rs): LUT export, Mixer Brush,
# Labels every registered language must carry: delete-layer prompt, image mode depth,
# New Document depth, Select menu dialogs (Select and Mask, Modify ▸ …)
